payload.rationale: This sprint retro directly touches three narratives and their supporting positions: the anti-Slack positioning thesis (Narrative_AntiSlackPositioning, Position_AntiPatternRealtimeChat, Position_ProductCategoryAsyncPlatform), the decisions-evaporate problem narrative (Narrative_DecisionsEvaporate, Position_ContextPreservationNextSprint), and the zero-effort capture / decision-at-consensus solution narratives (Narrative_ZeroEffortCapture, Narrative_DecisionCaptureAtConsensus, Position_CoreFeatureDecisionCapture). The Zephyr integration mention maps to Position_ZephyrIntegrationUnlock and its sibling Position_WebhookArchitecture under the same Sprint 4 retro. The velocity and thesis-proven claims connect to Position_Sprint4ThesisProven. Pricing positions (Position_PricingTwelveDollars, Position_PricingTier25Plus) and target market (Position_TargetMarketRemoteTeams) are included because the retro's velocity and shipping context could bear on pricing justification and ICP framing. No areas were deliberately excluded — the document is short but its claims radiate across the entire product narrative graph.
